sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Waetzig wants to reopen the dismissed case to challenge the arbitration award.
Halliburton wants the Court to block this challenge and enforce the arbitration award.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Waetzig argues that a voluntary dismissal is a final judgment that can be reopened under court rules.
Halliburton argues that the arbitration award must be challenged in the specific arbitration forum, not via a court motion.
